# Security Checklist: Backup coverage audit (docs/BACKUP-COVERAGE.md)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements on how the audit handles secrets, credentials and repository scope
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Evaluated by the agent at the reviewer's request (headless run); fixes were applied to spec/plan/contract where an item failed.

## Secret Handling

- [x] CHK001 - Does the spec itself (not only the plan/contract) forbid secret values in the document? [Gap, Spec §FR-014] — fixed: FR-014 added.
- [x] CHK002 - Is "secret value" defined concretely (keys, passwords, tokens, certificate material, the SES forward address)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK003 - Is it explicitly decided whether naming secret *locations* in a tracked doc is acceptable? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions "Naming secret locations publicly"] — fixed: decision recorded.
- [x] CHK004 - Is there a measurable check for "no secret values"? [Measurability, Quickstart §10] — fixed: gitleaks step added.

## Credential Recovery

- [x] CHK005 - Are the credentials that exist outside every backup (Kopia repository password, S3 keys) required to be named in the restore order? [Gap, Spec §FR-008] — fixed.
- [x] CHK006 - Is the Jenkins credential path on rebuild specified (JCasC + mounted `secrets/`, not the excluded master key)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006] — fixed.
- [x] CHK007 - Are certificate stores classified (Traefik `acme.json` gap; Roles Anywhere certs and Jenkins CA kept)? [Coverage, Research §R7, §R8]

## Scope & Change Safety

- [x] CHK008 - Is the change forbidden from altering backup rules, policies or scripts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK009 - Are paths that would block the agent pipeline's auto-merge (`jenkins/`, `ci/jenkins/`, `.github/`) excluded from the change? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context Constraints]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the handling of the sensitive LiteLLM database limited to description (no logging or data change)? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check III]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
